    Relative interiors of two-term presilting cones #

    Second assertion of Lemma 2.1(1) (lem:fan-lattice): the g-vector of any two-term complex lies in the relative interior of its g-vector cone (class_mem_intrinsicInterior_gVectorCone), and every vector in the fan support Σ(R) lies in the relative interior of C(P) for some two-term presilting complex P (mem_fanSupport_iff_cone_interior).
